scenario: Top-up plan pays only the excess above its deductible

scenario: Bill sits exactly at the deductible, so nothing is payable

claim.notes: Tests that a payable of zero is not confused with a rejection.

expected.reason: The claim is eligible, but the Rs 2,00,000 deductible consumes the entire Rs 2,00,000 bill, so nothing is payable. This is a deduction, not a rejection.
required_evidence: The Rs 2,00,000 deductible on record for UIN IRDA/NL-HLT/NIA/P-H/V.I/35/14-15
